properties.name: ML-DSA-87 (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k * l * n log n) polynomial operations, n=256, k=8, l=7
properties.algebraic_structure: Ring R_q = Z_q[X]/(X^256 + 1) with q = 8380417 (23-bit prime)

properties.name: Number Theoretic Transform (NTT over Z_8380417)
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) modular multiplications; Space: O(N), N=256
properties.ring_modulus: q = 8380417, primitive 256th root of unity w = 1753
properties.algorithm_variant: Cooley-Tukey radix-2 butterfly network with Montgomery and Barrett reductions

properties.name: ARM NEON Advanced SIMD (AArch64 / FEAT_AdvSIMD)
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 parallel 32-bit integer operations per 128-bit SIMD vector lane

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Signed Multiply-Add Long: multiplies lower/upper 32-bit elements in Vn and Vm, accumulates 64-bit result into Vd
Signed Saturating Doubling Multiply Returning High Half: calculates 2 * (Vn[i] * Vm[i]) >> 32 for Barrett/Montgomery multiplication reduction steps

properties.alignment_requirement: 16-byte boundary alignment for quadword LDR/STR vector instructions
properties.volatile_status: V0-V7, V16-V31 caller-saved; V8-V15 callee-saved low 64 bits (AAPCS64)

properties.operation: Accelerates vector polynomial matrix multiplications in signature generation and verification loops

properties.vector_width: 4x 32-bit polynomial coefficients vector-processed per 128-bit NEON lane

properties.stage: 64-bit wide product accumulation stage in 32-bit Montgomery reduction butterfly step
High-half fixed-point multiplication phase for Barrett modular reduction without 64-bit spill

properties.access_pattern: Reads 32-bit elements from Vn/Vm registers and writes 64-bit wide vector results to Vd
Read/Write 128-bit vector register holding 4 signed 32-bit polynomial coefficients

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 204: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard
ARM Architecture Reference Manual ARMv8, for ARMv8-A architecture profile (AArch64 Advanced SIMD)
